user.title: Connect to your Homepower
user.description:
Enter your battery's address. Auto-discovery found: {found}

The defaults below are the manufacturer's own published values and work on unmodified units.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the battery. Check the address, and note the gateway briefly drops off WiFi from time to time — try again.
error.invalid_auth: The username or password was rejected.
error.no_data: Connected, but no telemetry could be decoded. Is the vendor daemon running?
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.
error.mqtt_fields_missing: MQTT source needs the broker host, username, password and topic serial.
error.host_required: Enter the battery's address for the SSH source.

abort.already_configured: This battery is already set up.

init.title: OpenHomepower options
init.description:
Monitoring polls no faster than the battery refreshes (15-20s at best).

Control is optional and off by default. Turning it on lets Home Assistant WRITE settings to the battery via the broker below — the vendor broker to start with; point it at your own local broker later and nothing else changes. The topic serial is filled in automatically where possible.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Write a full weekly charge/discharge schedule (Manual mode). Complete overwrite — anything not listed is cleared.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Per day (mon-sun) and category (grid_charge, pv_charge, discharge): up to two windows, each with a start, end and power (0-100).
